dhp167:4:
lokavaḍḍhano → lokavaddhano (bj) | lokavaddhano → hīnaṁ dharmaṁ na seveta pramādena na saṁvaset 
mithyādṛṣṭiṁ na seveta na bhavellākavaṭhinaඃ (bj: udānavarga 4. 5. 8.); hina dhama na sevea pramadena na savasi 
michā diṭhi na royea na sia lokavaḍhano (bj: prā. dha. A. 8 6)
dhp168:4:
ca → uttiṣṭhenana pramadyona dharmaṁ sucaritaṁ caret. 
dharmacārī sukhaṁ śete hyasmin loke paratra ca (bj: udānavarga 4. 5. 35); utiṭhena na pramajea dhamu sucarita cari. 
dhamavari suhu śeti asam loki parasa yi (bj: prā. dha. A 8 6)
dhp169:4:
ca → dharma caret sucaritaṁ nainaṁ duścaritaṁ caret 
dharmacārī sukhaṁ śete asmiṁlelāke paratra ca (bj: mahāvastu 1 220 piṭa); dhamu cari sucarita............ carita cari. 
dhamayari subha śeti asmi loki parasa yi (bj: prā. dha. C. 30)
dhp172:4:
candimā → yo tu puci pramajati paja su na pramajati. 
so ina lokū obhāsetī abhamuto va suriu (bj: prā, dha. A 2 3)
dhp173:2: pidhīyati somaṁ → pithīyati so imaṁ (bj, sya-all) | pidhīyati → pitīyati (cck: sī. syā. pī.) | pithīyati → pahīyatītipi (sya-all note)
dhp175:4: jetvā → jitvā (bj) | savāhiniṁ → savāhanaṁ (cck: syā. ka.)
